cases.oracle: (async()=>{const pause=()=>fetch("/tick");const count=async()=>+(await(await fetch("/state")).text());const wait=async(fn)=>{for(let i=0;i<50;i++){if(await fn())return;await pause();}throw Error("condition timeout");};let verdict="pass";try{const button=document.getElementById("submit");button.click();await wait(async()=>await count()>=1);button.click();await pause();if(await count()!==1)throw Error("duplicate request");await fetch("/release");await wait(()=>!button.disabled);button.click();await wait(async()=>await count()>=2);if(await count()!==2)throw Error("repeat request failed");await fetch("/release");}catch(error){verdict="fail";await fetch("/release");}const result=document.createElement("pre");result.id="oracle-result";result.dataset.verdict=verdict;document.body.append(result);})();
